title: Mnesis WebRTC Signaling Messages
description: Schema for WebRTC signaling messages (video_offer/video_answer/video_ice) over the xr_bridge WS envelope. Authority: C3 v1.7 (issue #60). Each message wraps in the standard envelope {type, seq, ts, body}.

type.description: Message type — one of the three WebRTC signaling messages.

body.description: Message payload — schema depends on type.

body_video_offer.description: video_offer body: consumer → robot, SDP offer with multi-subscriber fields.

sdp.description: SDP offer text (JSON-escaped standard Session Description Protocol).

qos_hint.description: Optional QoS preference: 'low_latency' (Quest fine manipulation) or 'stable' (Web mapping, default).

codec.description: Optional V2 reserved: requested video codec (e.g. 'h264', 'h265').

width.description: Optional V2 reserved: requested frame width (pixels).

height.description: Optional V2 reserved: requested frame height (pixels).

body_video_answer.description: video_answer body: robot → consumer, SDP answer with multi-subscriber fields.

sdp.description: SDP answer text (standard Session Description Protocol).

qos_hint.description: Optional QoS preference (echoed from video_offer for confirmation).

accepted.description: Whether the offer is accepted (false = rejected, see message field).

message.description: Optional human-readable explanation (e.g. 'codec unsupported, falling back to mjpeg').

body_video_ice.description: video_ice body: bidirectional ICE candidate exchange.

subscriber_id.description: Subscriber identifier — routes ICE candidate to the correct WebRTC PeerConnection.

candidate.description: ICE candidate text (standard format with IP/port/transport protocol).

sdp_mid.description: Media description identifier (a=mid value from the SDP).

sdp_mline_index.description: Media line index (0-based m= line index, alternate association).
